objective: Turn verification-backed Treasury settlement evidence into read-only economic calibration and shadow route evaluation without creating another economic authority.

rulesConsidered: Treasury Constitutional Kernel remains the sole production economic authority.
Economic Intelligence is read-only and advisory.
Shadow route evaluation cannot execute, reserve, settle, release, freeze, or mutate pricing.
Quality, capability and latency constraints remain separate from economic scoring.
Unverified or low-confidence observations cannot drive promotion advice.
F07 remains the independent verification boundary.

notes: Calibration accepts only verification-backed Treasury settlement evidence.
Shadow evaluation receives a read-only TreasuryEconomicReadSource, never Treasury mutation APIs.
No provider execution or route override occurs in the evaluator.

conflicts.originalConflict: Economic Intelligence could influence live routing directly and become an implicit economic authority.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Keep calibration and counterfactual route evaluation in a separate read-only package with explicit shadow output.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: TreasuryEconomicCalibration and TreasuryShadowRouteEvaluator emit recommendations only; live admission remains Treasury Kernel.

conflicts.originalConflict: Cheap routes with insufficient quality or latency evidence could be promoted incorrectly.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Apply capability/workload, confidence, verification-success and latency gates before economic comparison.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Only candidates meeting configured evidence/quality/latency thresholds can become recommendations.

conflicts.originalConflict: Unverified settlement telemetry could contaminate learned economics.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Use only RESOURCE_CONSUMED events carrying verificationReceiptId for route calibration.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Unverified events remain telemetry but are excluded from calibration.

changes: Added TreasuryEconomicCalibration read model over verification-backed settlement evidence.
Added provider/model observed cost, latency, verification-success rate and confidence.
Added TreasuryShadowRouteEvaluator for counterfactual candidate-vs-baseline comparisons.
Separated quality/capability/latency gating from economic scoring.
Added dedicated Treasury Wave 6 validation workflow.
Added Wave 6 .okf decision and operating-contract updates.
verificationPlan: Treasury economic intelligence and authority-retirement regressions.
Repository CI and current-main ComputePool/F06/F07/Overseer/ReMaker regression matrix.
